item.title: Get started with Sleep as Android app
item.description:
Welcome to Sleep as Android! This guide will help you understand the benefits of sleep tracking and how to get the most out of your new sleep assistant.

Why Track Your Sleep?#

Sleep is a fundamental pillar of health. Consistent monitoring helps you understand how your lifestyle choices (like caffeine, exercise, or late-night screen time) impact your rest.

The two main benefits are:

  1. Insight: Identify long-term patterns and improve your sleep habits over time.
  2. Smart Wake-up: Our signature feature identifies when you are in a light sleep phase and wakes you up gently, preventing that “groggy” feeling in the morning.

What Does the App Measure?#

To build a 360-degree map of your night, Sleep as Android analyzes data from several sources:

item.title: Permissions
item.description:
To provide its comprehensive suite of features, Sleep as Android requires specific system permissions. Below is a detailed breakdown of how and why each permission is used.

Permission Feature(s) Using This Why it’s needed
Microphone
  • Sleep noise recording
  • Sonar tracking
 Required to analyze sleep sounds (snoring, talking) or to use ultrasonic waves for contactless movement tracking.
Location
  • Sunrise wakeup
  • Geotagging
  • Pair tracking
  • Bluetooth wearables
 Used to detect local sunrise times and weather. Note: Coarse location (±5 km) is used for tags. Precise location is required by Android to scan for Bluetooth/BLE devices.
Camera
  • CAPTCHA tasks
  • Flashlight cues
  • Pee-light
 Used to scan QR codes/barcodes for CAPTCHAs, or to detect your smile. Also required to control the physical flashlight for visual alerts.
Storage / Media
  • Backup & Restore
  • Sound recording
 Used to export your sleep data to CSV and to store your nightly audio recordings on your device.
Nearby Devices / Bluetooth
  • Smartwatches
  • Sleep Phaser
  • Oximeters
 Required to communicate with and collect data from external hardware and wearables.
Body Sensors Heart rate monitoring Required to read real-time pulse and HRV data from your smartwatch or chest strap.
Phone / Call Info Alarms & Recording Used to automatically mute alarms or pause recording if you are currently on an active phone call.
Calendar Google Calendar Allows the app to automatically skip alarms on public holidays or reschedule them based on your upcoming events.
Display over other apps Fullscreen alarms Required for the alarm screen to appear over your lock screen. Also necessary for Spotify to launch during an alarm.
Notifications Alerts Required to send you “Time to go to bed” reminders and “Are you still awake?” checks.
Battery Optimization (Ignore) Sleep Tracking Essential for preventing the system from killing the app in the middle of the night. Learn more at DontKillMyApp.com.

Technical & Other Permissions#

  • Near Field Communication (NFC): Used exclusively for the NFC CAPTCHA task.
  • Run at startup: Ensures your scheduled alarms remain active even after your phone reboots.
  • Prevent device from sleeping (Wakelock): Keeps the app active so sensors can continue reading data throughout the entire night.
  • Full network access: Used for cloud backups, online radio streams, and weather updates.
  • Vibration control: Allows the app to trigger haptic feedback for alarms and cues.

item.title: Privacy
item.description:
Manage your data, ad preferences, and tracking settings to protect your privacy.

Sleep as Android is designed with privacy in mind. For the most up-to-date details on how we handle your data, please see the Official Urbandroid Privacy Policy.

Menu Path: Settings → Personalize → Privacy

Data & Usage#

Analytics#

Allows you to opt-out of anonymous usage statistics. These statistics help us understand aggregate trends, such as which Android versions are most common or which sensors (like Sonar) are most popular.

item.title: Purchasing the app
item.description:
We offer two intertwined apps — Sleep as Android and SleepCloud — each with free and premium versions to fit your needs.

FREE Sleep as Android#

The free version is perfect for testing the app’s core capabilities before committing to a purchase.

Feature Free Version Capability
Trial Period 14 days of full, unrestricted access to all features.
Sleep Tracking After the trial, tracking is limited to every other day (active on Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat, Sun; limited on Tue, Thu).
Non-Tracking Features Alarms, Lullabies, CAPTCHAs, and Bedtime notifications work without limits.
Advertisements The free app includes advertisements after the trial period expires.

FULL Sleep as Android#

The full version unlocks unlimited sleep tracking and advanced features. Your purchase directly supports our team and the continued development of the app.

item.title: Translation
item.description:
Sleep as Android is translated into many world languages, thanks to our incredible community of volunteer translators. We could never achieve this without your help!

Can you help us with translations?#

As we add new features, we frequently need help translating new text strings. If you’d like to contribute, please request access to our translation spreadsheets below:

  • Sleep as Android Translation Spreadsheet
  • SleepCloud Translation Spreadsheet
  • BabySleep Translation Spreadsheet
  • Twilight Translation Spreadsheet
  • Digital Detox Translation Spreadsheet

We use Translate the Sheet to streamline the process for our volunteers.
